in_marathi.name: Jagpal
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Lord of the World
in_marathi.long_meaning: Jagpal हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Jagat (world) + Pal (protector). Jagpal is a Sanskrit name that means 'Lord of the World' or 'Protector of the World'. This name is derived from the Sanskrit words jagat (world) and pal (protector). It is a powerful and spiritual name that represents strength, protection, and leadership.
